# Polynet Product Docs

This is the compact LLM entrypoint for Polynet product documentation.
Use it to choose the smallest relevant document before reading full context.

## Platform Value Prop

Polynet lets builders create communities that can think, remember, and act with AI.
The platform combines community, services, consulting, software, agents, skills, apps, MCPs, resources, access control, and payments into one services-as-software business surface.

## Retrieval Rule

Read only the specific docs needed for the task. Prefer precise slugs over broad context.

## Default Document

- `primitives/polynet`

## Directory

- `primitives/polynet` (Primitives) — Polynet: What Polynet is, why it exists, and the alpha product model.
- `primitives/community` (Primitives) — Community: The community as the trust, access, and shared intelligence container.
- `primitives/agent` (Primitives) — Agent: How the member agent uses platform, conversation, and community context.
- `primitives/community-lens` (Primitives) — Community Lens: The server-validated community context applied to subsequent member-agent turns.
- `primitives/thread` (Primitives) — Thread: The internal durable conversation record and context audit boundary.
- `primitives/memory` (Primitives) — Memory: The current personal memory scope and future memory boundaries.
- `primitives/funnel` (Primitives) — Funnel: The canonical public entry surface for community joining and access.
- `primitives/voice` (Primitives) — Voice: Voice input as a core member interaction surface.
- `primitives/app-mcp` (Primitives) — Apps And MCPs: External capability and context surfaces for agents.
- `primitives/skill` (Primitives) — Skill: Reusable instruction or capability packages for repeated behavior.
- `primitives/resource` (Primitives) — Resource: Community-owned durable knowledge available to members and agents where allowed.
- `primitives/entitlement` (Primitives) — Entitlement: Durable backend access truth for products, communities, plans, and capabilities.
- `primitives/role` (Primitives) — Role: Community authority level, separate from entitlement and payment state.
- `guides/builder-quickstart` (Builder Guides) — Builder Quickstart: A compact build order for launching a community intelligence system.
- `guides/launch-a-community` (Builder Guides) — Launch A Community: How to create, configure, gate, and share a community.
- `guides/manage-resources` (Builder Guides) — Manage Resources: How builders should curate community knowledge without confusing it with private memory.
- `guides/configure-community-agent` (Builder Guides) — Configure Community Agent: How builders should shape the community agent and its context.
- `guides/connect-apps-and-mcps` (Builder Guides) — Connect Apps And MCPs: How apps and MCP servers fit into capability and context.
- `guides/create-and-use-skills` (Builder Guides) — Create And Use Skills: How skills package repeatable agent behavior.
- `guides/manage-access-billing-and-roles` (Builder Guides) — Manage Access, Billing, And Roles: The builder mental model for entitlements, payments, and roles.
- `guides/member-quickstart` (Member Guides) — Member Quickstart: How members join, use communities, and work with the agent.
- `guides/joining-communities` (Member Guides) — Joining Communities: How members should understand funnels, access, and joining.
- `guides/community-lens` (Member Guides) — Community Lens: How community pages provide authorized context to the member agent.
- `guides/chat-and-resources` (Member Guides) — Chat And Resources: The member mental model for live chat and durable community knowledge.
- `reference/context-model` (Reference) — Context Model: The canonical context precedence and explicit exclusions.
- `reference/prompt-context-model` (Reference) — Prompt Context Model: How documentation should feed prompt and context design.
- `reference/access-model` (Reference) — Access Model: How access decisions are made from auth, membership, and entitlement.
- `reference/roles-permissions` (Reference) — Roles And Permissions: Owner, admin, moderator, and member authority boundaries.
- `reference/billing-entitlements` (Reference) — Billing And Entitlements: The authority model for paid access, checkout, and subscriptions.
- `reference/security-privacy` (Reference) — Security And Privacy: Security and privacy boundaries for community and agent systems.
- `reference/glossary` (Reference) — Glossary: Stable terms for product, builder, member, and agent docs.
